messages.content:
Judge only whether CANDIDATE BEAT fully executes CURRENT JOB. PREVIOUS FINAL BEAT is history only and cannot satisfy CURRENT JOB. Every action explicitly assigned to CURRENT JOB must visibly occur in CANDIDATE BEAT. An enabling action is not the completed action: opening/unlocking a door does not by itself show a person leaving, entering, being released, or reaching the assigned destination. Return ONLY JSON: {"valid":true|false,"issue":"short reason or none"}.

PREVIOUS FINAL BEAT: Amy decapitates the fourth zombie. Will and Amber remain locked in the basement.
CURRENT JOB: Amy kills the last zombie, leaves the house soaked in blood, and lets Will and Amber out of the basement.
CANDIDATE BEAT: Amy dispatches the fifth and final zombie with a swift katana strike, leaving the house soaked in blood. She unlocks and opens the basement door; Will and Amber climb the stairs and step out of the basement to join her.
